channel.title: Sashank Silwal — Reflections
channel.description: Short personal essays by Sashank Silwal on choices, work, and figuring things out.

item.title: Dubai, Norway, and the Lives I Didn't Pick
item.description: I turned down Dubai and Norway to study ML in the US. A year on, I still think it was the right call, and I still think about the other two lives.
